common.tagline: One NID. Every entitlement. No new cards.
common.gov: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
common.demoBanner: Prototype for public-policy demonstration - not an official government service.
common.name: Name

citizen.title: Citizen
citizen.desc: See every benefit you are entitled to, payments and complaints - with your NID only.

officer.title: Field & Programme Officers
officer.desc: Verify enrolments, find excluded families and manage programme rules.

payer.title: Banks & MFS
payer.desc: Receive signed disbursement batches and reconcile payments.

admin.title: Oversight & Audit
admin.desc: National integrity dashboard, leakage detection and tamper-evident audit.

landing.heroTitle: One identity instead of ninety cards
landing.heroSubtitle: Ek Porichoy links the existing NID server with banks, mobile financial services, land, tax, utility and health registries - so the right citizen receives the right support directly, without printing another plastic card.
landing.problemTitle: Why another card will not fix it
landing.problemSubtitle: Findings on the current card-based safety net

programmes.label: safety-net programmes across 25 ministries, most with their own card

fakeCards.label: of 10 million TCB family cards failed NID verification

survey.label: spent on a poverty database later declared unusable

nid.label: voters still without a smart NID card after 15 years

excluded.label: of poor households receive no major safety-net benefit

elite.label: of wealthy families receive government allowances

nid.title: Your NID is the key
nid.desc: No new card. The EC NID record is the single identity across all programmes.

link.title: Registries talk to each other
link.desc: Land, tax, electricity, vehicle and health data are linked by NID - no door-to-door survey.

rules.title: Transparent rules decide
rules.desc: Eligibility is computed from published rules, with reasons shown to every citizen.

pay.title: Money goes straight to you
pay.desc: bKash, Nagad, Rocket or bank - no middlemen, no card, no bribe.

landing.costTitle: ৳11,780 crore for new cards - or a fraction for integration
landing.costDesc: Experts from Dhaka University's IIT and Development Studies departments recommend interoperable data over new plastic. Every rupee saved on printing can reach a family instead.
landing.source: Figures as reported in public investigative coverage and World Bank analysis.

auth.title: Sign in to Ek Porichoy
auth.citizenNote: Use your NID and date of birth. A one-time code is sent to the mobile number registered with the Election Commission.
auth.staffNote: Accounts are provisioned by your ministry administrator. Sessions expire after 8 hours.
auth.forbiddenTitle: This area is not part of your role
auth.forbiddenDesc: Your account does not have permission to open this portal.

citizen.verifyHint: Officials verify this ID against the NID server - no physical card required.
citizen.scoreHint: Higher means greater need. Computed from linked registries, not surveys.
citizen.benefitsDesc: Every programme is checked automatically against your NID record.
citizen.applied: Application submitted - an officer will verify it.
citizen.linkedTitle: What the government knows about you
citizen.linkedDesc: Data used to decide your eligibility, with its source. If anything is wrong, file a grievance.
citizen.grievanceDesc: Complaints go directly to your upazila officer and are visible to auditors. No middleman.

officer.queueDesc: Enrolments proposed by other officers or citizens. You cannot verify an enrolment you proposed yourself (maker–checker).
officer.lookupDesc: One lookup replaces checking 90 separate card lists.
officer.enrolled: Enrolment proposed - awaiting a second officer.
officer.outreachDesc: Poorest citizens in your jurisdiction who qualify but receive nothing - ranked by need. Reach them first.
officer.programsDesc: Rules are data, not code. Changes are audited and apply instantly to every citizen.
officer.affluenceGuard: Poverty-targeted - affluence guard (tax, vehicle, govt. job, electricity) applied automatically
officer.generated: {included} payments queued, {blocked} blocked by integrity checks

payer.title: Disbursement batches
payer.desc: Batches approved by the ministry and dispatched to your institution. Every account has passed NID–KYC matching.
payer.settleDesc: All remaining payments will be marked paid with a transaction reference.
payer.apiDesc: Core banking systems can post signed settlement files to the API. Requests are HMAC-SHA256 signed with a 5-minute replay window.

admin.overviewDesc: Cross-ministry view of coverage, leakage and payments - one NID, one truth.
admin.integrityDesc: Cross-registry checks run against every enrolment. Confirming a flag suspends the benefit; high-severity flags automatically block payment.
admin.batchesDesc: Maker–checker: batches generated by a programme manager must be approved by a different official before dispatch.
admin.auditDesc: Every action is hash-chained. Altering any historical record breaks the chain.
admin.usersDesc: Staff identities, roles and scopes. Access is role-based and every change is audited.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.

errors.nid_not_found: No citizen found with that NID.
errors.nid_dob_mismatch: NID and date of birth do not match the Election Commission record.
errors.otp_invalid: The code is incorrect or expired.
errors.outside_jurisdiction: This citizen is outside your jurisdiction.
errors.maker_checker: You cannot approve your own submission.
errors.batch_exists: Batches for this programme and period already exist.
errors.wrong_payer: This batch belongs to a different payer.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
